aboutPage.title: What is CREUP?
aboutPage.description: We are the leading student representation platform for public universities in Spain.
aboutPage.lead: We are a state association that brings together the student councils of public universities, giving a voice to more than one million students across Spain.
aboutPage.intro: We coordinate national student representation and defend our rights and participation in university policymaking.
aboutPage.dynamicContentLoadErrorDescription: Reference values are shown while the connection recovers.
aboutPage.identityParagraph1: We act as interlocutors with key institutions so that our perspective as students is part of university policy-making.
aboutPage.identityParagraph2: Our goal is to ensure that students' voices are heard in building and improving the university system, promoting a public education model that is high-quality, inclusive, and accessible.
aboutPage.activityParagraph1: We hold two General Assemblies each year where we agree on priorities, positions, and shared strategic lines.
aboutPage.activityParagraph2: We promote training events and spaces for exchanging experiences and views among student representatives and other social actors in the university system.
aboutPage.purposeParagraph: We give students a voice and work every day for a fairer, more participatory, and higher-quality Higher Education system. We believe in public universities as a driver of social mobility.
aboutPage.missionText: To give university students a voice in building and improving the Spanish University System, promoting Higher Education that is high-quality, accessible, and inclusive. We work so that our rights, needs, and interests are heard and considered in decision-making.
aboutPage.visionText: To become the leading student representation body at the national level, serving as a link with associations, institutions, and public and private organizations, both nationally and internationally. We aim to help build a university system that is fairer, more innovative, and better adapted to society's needs.
aboutPage.valuesDescription: The student representation model we promote is grounded in clear and shared principles.

equalityPage.lead: On this page you can consult documents and resources related to equality, diversity, discrimination prevention, and the basic information about the Safe Point we have in place during assemblies, meetings, and other events.

equalityPage.actionTitle: If something happens during one of our events

safety.title: Prioritize safety
safety.description: If there is an immediate risk, leave the situation, look for support from someone you trust, and contact 112 or emergency services if needed.

notify.title: Report what happened
notify.description: During the event you can approach the Safe Point, the trusted people assigned to it, or the person responsible for equality in the extended Executive Committee. If you need to report it later, you can use this email.

details.title: Gather relevant information
details.description: Write down dates, places, people involved, and any available evidence. The protocols stress only asking for the necessary information and protecting confidentiality.

support.title: Read the protocol and ask for support
support.description: The protocols explain what safeguards are in place, which protective measures can be activated, and how to ask for support if sexual harassment or discrimination takes place.

equalityPage.pointSafeDescription: The Safe Point is the resource we have in place at our events to offer information, a listening ear, and support in situations involving sexual harassment or discrimination.
equalityPage.pointSafeCalloutDescription: The Safe Point operates on the ground during assemblies, meetings, and other activities we organize. At each event, at least one trusted person is appointed and their contact details are shared with all attendees.

prevention.title: Before anything happens
prevention.description: It helps set expectations, share the protocols, and make clear that our events are meant to be safe and respectful spaces.

guidance.title: When someone needs support
guidance.description: It offers a clear point of contact where someone can pause, explain what happened, get guidance, and think through the next steps.

followUp.title: If follow-up is needed
followUp.description: It helps document what happened, connect with the responsible people, and continue the support process with the level of discretion each case needs.

scopeItems.sexualViolence: Sexual harassment and conduct against sexual freedom
scopeItems.gender: Sexism, gender-based violence, and structural inequality
scopeItems.lgbtiq: Sexual orientation, identity, and gender expression
scopeItems.ethnicity: Racism, xenophobia, and discrimination based on origin or ethnicity
scopeItems.otherDiscrimination: Other forms of discrimination based on age, social condition, or other personal or social circumstances

equalityPage.supportTitle: Do you need to contact the Safe Point?
equalityPage.supportDescription: If you want to tell us about something that happened during one of our events or you need guidance, you can email the Safe Point directly. This page gives you the documents and the contact route; support itself is provided in the context of the activities we organize. In urgent situations, also use the specialized services at your university, in your area, or call 112.

mic.title: Corporate Identity Manual
mic.description: Core elements of CREUP's visual identity: logos, corporate colors, and the full brand manual.
mic.introParagraph1: This Visual Identity Manual contains the core elements of the visual identity of the Coordinadora de Representantes de Estudiantes de Universidades Públicas, hereinafter CREUP.
mic.introParagraph2: These elements establish the construction guidelines, typography usage, and chromatic applications of the brand. Consolidating the brand image requires special attention to the recommendations set out in this manual, as a document that ensures consistency in public communication and outreach.
mic.introParagraph3: The manual should therefore be a dynamic tool, present in all corporate image applications. It remains, however, open to the creativity of the person using it.
mic.logosDescription: Below you can view and download all CREUP logo variants. The brand must always be reproduced following the corporate standards set out in this manual. Therefore,
mic.logosWarning: colors and proportions must never be altered.
mic.colorsDescription: In addition to white, these are the corporate colors and their codes.
